entities.name: UL information transfer procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE or IAB-MT to transfer NAS dedicated information or F1-C related information.

entities.name: ULInformationTransfer message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate UL information transfer procedure.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE is connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE during SDT
entities.description: RRC inactive state during Small Data Transmission.

entities.name: Need to transfer NAS dedicated information
entities.description: Condition triggering UL information transfer procedure for UE.

entities.name: Need to transfer F1-C related information
entities.description: Condition triggering UL information transfer procedure for IAB-MT.

entities.name: SBR2 established
entities.description: Condition required for IAB-MT to initiate procedure for F1-C information transfer.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated by sending ULInformationTransfer message.
Procedure can be initiated when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure can be initiated when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state during SDT.
Procedure initiation is triggered by need to transfer NAS dedicated information.
Procedure initiation for IAB-MT is triggered by need to transfer F1-C related information.
IAB-MT procedure initiation requires SBR2 to be established.
IAB-MT procedure initiation requires split SRB2 to be established.
